summary: Iteration 3 tested on the 390x844 web preview and the public backend. Every requested feature passed. Shop prices: Vasetto 8€, Brodino 5€, Tortellini 15€, Caffè 25€. Buying 1 Vasetto and 1 Brodino took money from 220€ to 207€, and the save was on the backend within about 1s. Trainer rewards are doubled: Studente showed 'Hai ricevuto 120 €' (100→220€) and Tonello showed 'Hai ricevuto 240 €' (100→340€). A wild win against a Lv3 monster paid +34€ (10+3*8) and showed a '+34 €' toast. Losing kept 75% of the money (1000→750€), healed the team and returned the player to the heal spot. Map markers rendered: marker-heal-bo_sfoglina (CURA), marker-shop-bo_bottega (MARKET), marker-heal-og_oste, crossed swords on trainers and a crown on bosses. Tonello (npc-og_tonello): 2-line dialog, battle with Mortazzone, Cinghialotto and Passatellone in order, defeat saved, re-talk shows only the after line. Battle effects: floating damage numbers (-27, -29) and target blink appeared in screenshots, and the super-effective path ran with no errors. No crashes or console errors across multi-turn battles, Brodino use in battle, voluntary switch, forced switch, catch (Mortazzone) and evolution (Fanghino to Fangone). Fixes from iteration 2 confirmed: Fangone was added to caught/seen and persisted; the A button advances an open dialog; Brodino use on the team screen was saved quickly; a fresh load with no token gave 0 console errors (no 401); a beaten boss (Gino) repeats only his last line. Holding the D-pad walked 10 tiles in 1.78s (about 170ms per step, no freeze). Exits Bologna→Osteria Grande and Imola→Riviera work, 'Salva ora' works, and login + continue work for test@bologna.it. Existing backend pytest suite: 16/16 passed. Deprecated packages detected: none (no expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner or expo-background-fetch).

issues: Defeated trainers and beaten bosses keep the crossed-swords or crown badge, so the player cannot tell who is still to fight. Consider dimming the badge or showing a check mark when save.defeated includes the NPC id (would need a defeated prop on TileMap).
The map-change toast at the top centre can cover NPC badges on the top visible row for about 2s. Cosmetic only.

action_items: LOW (optional UX): Mark defeated trainers and bosses differently on the map (dimmed badge or check icon).
LOW: Movement-only changes still rely on the 2.5s save debounce. Consider flushing on web pagehide/visibilitychange so position is not lost if the tab closes right after walking.
critical_code_review_comments: game.tsx onBattleEnd: reward*2, wildPay = 10+lv*8 and the 75% loss rule match the spec. The party-species loop correctly adds evolved species to caught/seen.

The Tonello teleport hint in the review request, osteria (3,4), is a roof tile ('R', which blocks movement). During play Tonello is reached from (2,3), (4,3) or (3,2). This only affects crafted test saves, not gameplay.
PixelSprite caches Scale2x grids per name and merges horizontal runs, so performance is fine on web. On native devices the fractional px sizes may show hairline seams; worth checking on device.
Catch rate at full HP is about 26% for catchRate 0.7, so 6 failed throws in a row happened once. That is within expected odds, not a bug.
